description: Crab, the young apprentice from the pier who merges every fix and keeps the contributors list. Shown on MergeCelebration and the Contributors screen (the Pier).

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: Merged! Your fix is in. Clack clack!
pieces.dev_note: Replaces the plain 'Merged!' label; pick one of the crab.merged group each time.

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: In it goes! Listen. The machine already sounds happier.

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: Merged! I'm writing you down in my good pencil.

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: Every fix counts, big or small. This one's merged!

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: Merged! The gnu would have done a little dance.
I'm doing it for him. Sideways, of course.

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: Snip, snip, merged. Thank you for fixing that!

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: Merged! That's one more thing that isn't only in one head anymore.

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: Your first fix! You offered a change, I checked it, and I added it in.
That's all a pull request is: asking to add your fix, and someone saying yes.
pieces.dev_note: Show once, on the first credited solve, before the name prompt.

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: Want your name on the contributors list? It goes up on the big screen.
Up to 20 letters. Or stay anonymous. Both count just the same.
pieces.dev_note: Replaces 'Put your name on the contributors list?'. Buttons stay 'Add my name' / 'Stay anonymous'.

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: I merged the fix. The machine doesn't mind how it got solved.
Solve one yourself next time, and I'll add your name to the list.
pieces.dev_note: Replaces 'Crab merged the fix. Solve one yourself to get on the list.'

pieces.speaker: Crab
lines: This is my list of everyone who fixed something. It used to be one name.
Now look at it! Every name here means the machines need one gnu less.
